duration: One year, at least one weekday evening shift per week
name: High School Volunteer at SSM Health Cardinal Glennon
org: SSM Health Cardinal Glennon Children's Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteers help the hospital team. They may visit patient rooms, read books, work in play areas or help move patients. They work one weekday evening shift each week for a year.
who_can_apply: High school students who are at least 17 when they apply and in the spring of their junior year. Students must go to a one-hour information meeting and a 3-hour orientation.
deadline_text: The 2026-2027 application period has closed. The program page says the new timeline will be posted in fall 2026.
how_to_apply: Check the program page this fall for the new timeline. You need an application, an interview, health requirements, a background check and two references.
notes: Spots are limited. The hospital takes one student per school and at most four students at a time during the school day.
